data.name: Hayah
data.gender_notes: Hayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hayah is derived from the Arabic root 'h.y.h', meaning 'to live' or 'existence'. In Islamic context, it symbolizes the essence of life and the continuous process of existence. This name is mentioned in the Quran in verse 40:68. The name Hayah carries the meaning “Life, Existence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hayah usually hope their child will grow to embody life, existence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
